results.title: Beacon acquires 314 Capital and aims to manage over R$1 billion | TI INSIDE Online
results.author: Redaction
highlights:
Beacon acquires 314 Capital and aims to manage over R$1 billion | TI INSIDE Online
...
Saturday, August 15, 2026
...
Home Newsletter (TI Inside) Beacon acquires 314 Capital and aims to raise over R$1 billion...
...
With a focus on Brazilian technology entrepreneurs and executives, Beacon is entering a new phase of expansion. The company, specializing in wealth management for entrepreneurs, investors, and executives in the technology ecosystem, announces the acquisition of 314 Capital, consolidating its evolution into an integrated family office platform. With this acquisition, the company projects exceeding R$1 billion in assets under management (AuM) by 2026, expands its client base by 28% to serve 60 families, and strengthens its work with entrepreneurs from companies such as Tempest, Flash, Fanatee, BeConfident, Bhub, Musa, Kamino, Sanii, MeSalva, Uber, QuintoAndar, among others.
...
The incorporation of 314 Capital strengthens a partnership initiated in 2025 and expands Beacon's range of solutions, which will now offer, on a single platform, investment management with integrated legal and tax support. The operation also marks the arrival of two new partners: Alfredo Cunha, with experience at BTG Pactual and Julius Baer, and Juliana Brasil, formerly of BTG and Deloitte, who will join the team alongside Ricardo Coelho Duarte, CEO of Beacon, and Natan Epstein, CIO of Beacon and Founder of 314.

results.title: Beacon Acquires 314 Capital, Expands Wealth Management Services
highlights:
Beacon Acquires 314 Capital, Expands Wealth Management Services
...
Beacon Founders, a prominent family office catering to technology entrepreneurs, has significantly expanded its operational capabilities through the strategic incorporation of 314 Capital. This move, orchestrated during the recent South Summit Brazil event, integrates 314 Capital's regulated asset management expertise into Beacon's existing framework, aiming to propel the firm's assets under management past the R$ 1 billion mark by 2026.
...
The transaction, structured as a share exchange rather than a cash deal, sees Natan Epstein, the founder of 314 Capital, assume the role of Chief Investment Officer (CIO) at Beacon. This integration immediately elevates Beacon's managed assets to R$ 650 million, combining the R$ 400 million previously managed by 314 Capital with Beacon's R$ 140 million in existing equity pool investments. The acquisition is pivotal for Beacon, enabling it to secure a crucial CVM (Brazil's securities regulator) asset management license, thereby broadening its service offerings beyond illiquid private equity stakes.
...
Natan Epstein's 314 Capital, which will cease to operate under its original brand, was established in 2023 following his sale of the multi-family office Troon to Blue3. His previous venture managed assets with a significant tilt towards the technology sector, aligning perfectly with Beacon's core demographic. This demographic includes founders of established tech companies, those who have recently exited their ventures, and senior executives within the technology industry.

results.title: Corten Capital and Ampersand Capital Partners Complete Acquisition of Beacon Intelligence to Accelerate Growth in Life Sciences R&D Intelligence | Ampersand Capital Partners
results.author: Kathleen P. Toomey
highlights: London, UK, 30th June 2026 – Corten Capital and Ampersand Capital Partners (“Ampersand”) are pleased to announce the completion of their acquisition of Beacon Intelligence (“Beacon” or the “Company”) from the Hanson Wade Group, backed by Graphite Capital. Beacon is the third investment from Corten Capital II, which closed in March 2024 with €680 million in capital commitments. Ampersand is investing alongside Corten as a minority co-investor in the transaction. As the new majority owner, Corten Capital is partnering with Beacon’s management, led by its CEO Rob Poolman and Chair Sati S. Sian, to support the next phase of Beacon’s growth as an independent company. David Anderson, General Partner at Ampersand, will join the Board of Directors alongside Corten Capital and Sati S. Sian, who will continue as Chair.

results.title: Beacon compra 314 Capital e prepara FIDC para financiar startups — Fidc News
highlights:
A Beacon, plataforma de gestão patrimonial voltada a fundadores de empresas de tecnologia, anunciou a aquisição da gestora 314 Capital. A operação amplia o modelo de negócio da companhia, que passa a somar participações societárias, gestão de patrimônio e, a partir de 2026, crédito privado estruturado por meio de um FIDC (Fundo de Investimento em Direitos Creditórios) voltado ao próprio ecossistema de startups que já atende.
...
Com a aquisição da 314 Capital, gestora fundada em 2023 por Natan Epstein, a Beacon incorpora à sua estrutura um time com histórico em gestão de recursos e mercado de capitais. Epstein assume o cargo de CIO (Chief Investment Officer) da Beacon, posição que centraliza as decisões de alocação e estratégia de investimentos da companhia daqui para frente.
...
Fonte: Business Moment, "Beacon compra 314 Capital e prepara FIDC para startups", 14 de agosto de 2026 (businessmoment.com.br)
